verdict.rationale: Mobile apps are a fair question for a consumer AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that Poke runs inside third-party messaging channels (Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, RCS). Those are host-platform surfaces, not official Poke iOS or Android apps, and the pack documents no Poke-built mobile app on either platform.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android
